title: Sources: SpaceX and Tesla are negotiating an all-stock, $3.5T merger led by two special committees of five "disinterested" directors, all with ties to Elon Musk (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: SpaceX and Tesla are negotiating an all-stock, $3.5T merger led by two special committees of five “disinterested” directors, all with ties to Elon Musk — SpaceX and Tesla have entrusted five directors with the fate of the largest merger of all time …
